text: No, the evidence does not support that this property lost tree cover in 2019. While one dataset (Hansen) detected 1.8 ha of potential tree-cover loss, an independent reference (JRC) found no agreement (0% of the area). The latest analysis contradicts the claim, as corroboration requires both agreement with the reference and observation in a later year. The loss was also below the minimum event threshold (0.5 ha). The evidence does not confirm whether any actual tree-cover loss occurred, nor its cause.
